active_pullup.docs:
**defaults to `false`**: enables DS2484 `active_pullup`.

*See also: [1-Wire Bus via DS2484](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds2484#configuration-variables)*

address.docs:
**int**: The I²C address of the device. Defaults to `0x18`.

*See also: [1-Wire Bus via DS2484](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds2484#configuration-variables)*

i2c_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [I2C](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/). Required if you have configured multiple I2C busses.

*See also: [1-Wire Bus via DS2484](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds2484#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation. Required if you have multiple 1-Wire busses.

*See also: [1-Wire Bus via DS2484](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds2484#configuration-variables)*

strong_pullup.docs:
**defaults to `false`**: enables DS2484 `strong_pullup`.

*See also: [1-Wire Bus via DS2484](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds2484#configuration-variables)*
